subunit: Monomer. Component of an EIF2 complex at least composed of CELF1/CUGBP1, CALR, CALR3, EIF2S1, EIF2S2, HSP90B1 and HSPA5. Interacts with PDIA3/ERp57 and SPACA9. Interacts with TRIM21. Interacts with NR3C1. Interacts with PPIB. Interacts (via P-domain) with PDIA5. Interacts with GABARAP. Interacts with HLA-E-B2M and HLA-G-B2M complexes. Interacts with HLA-F. Interacts with CLCC1
